native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: The 17th century BCE is when Diversity in Pottery Form collapses while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneously.
native_result.WorkflowB: Used the 37 raw 100-yr bin values from time_series_data.csv (PotteryForm and PotteryDecoration columns, one point every 100 years from CE -4100 to -500). Computed first-differences (diff) on the 100-yr grid for both series, then flagged bins where Form collapses (ΔForm < -0.5) AND Decoration increases (ΔDeco > +0.5). Exactly one bin qualified: CE -1700, where ΔForm = -1.87 (0.74 → -1.13, the largest negative Form delta in the series) and ΔDeco = +1.45 (-0.48 → 0.97). An adjacent-bin (±100 yr) robustness check found no other qualifying bin in the window, confirming the event is isolated. CE -1700 = 1700 BCE, which maps to the 17th century BCE. (Note: signals are Z-standardised, so 'collapse'/'increase' are relative to the long-run mean, not absolute counts.) capital.csv cross-check: BCE 1700 row (ZKeform -1.13, Zkeverz 0.97) mirrors the same time_series point.

sub_hypo.context: The CE -1700 (1700 BCE) bin, identified in the workflow as the 17th century BCE, within 37 raw 100-year bins spanning CE -4100 to -500. Signals are Z-standardised, representing changes relative to the long-run mean rather than absolute counts.
sub_hypo.relations: Simultaneous pottery-form diversity collapse (100-year first difference ΔForm < -0.5) and pottery-decoration diversity increase (ΔDeco > +0.5). At CE -1700, Form falls from 0.74 to -1.13 (ΔForm = -1.87, the largest negative Form change), while Decoration rises from -0.48 to 0.97 (ΔDeco = +1.45). This is the only qualifying bin in the series, with no other qualifying bin in the adjacent ±100-year window; the capital.csv BCE 1700 values ZKeform = -1.13 and Zkeverz = 0.97 corroborate the same point.
